subject: Marine Works - Canfisco Bay - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Canfisco Bay - Fraser River
Marine works for the placement of scour protection near the Canfisco Bay 49 07.456N 123 04.585W. 
Hours of operation 1400UTC Nov 8 to 0200UTC Nov 14. 
Vessels on site monitoring VHF Ch.16, 71 and 74.
Mariners requested to avoid the marine equipment staging area.
